request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Crucible Crab".

Creative brief
Name: Crucible Crab
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A broad defensive enemy that pours molten streams while moving sideways.
Body and silhouette: Wide six-legged crab with a deep bowl-shaped shell and two asymmetrical iron claws.
Signature features: Open crucible back, molten contents, and pouring spouts on both sides.
Palette and materials: Black iron, orange-yellow metal, dark rust, and cooled slag gray.
Movement personality: Sideways, measured, and territorial.
Attack concept: Tilts its shell while strafing, releasing evenly spaced molten droplets in a line parallel to its movement.
Directional details: The left claw is narrow while the right claw is hammer-shaped.
Avoid: Ocean crab colors, cooking pot appearance, liquid covering the entire sprite.
